Is Mon 2 Nov a holiday in Mumbai?
7:48 PM

No, Mon 2 Nov wasn't a public holiday in Mumbai as far as I know. This year's Diwali holidays fell later, around Sun 8 Nov to Wed 11 Nov. I can't check live calendars, so for a bank or office rule, trust their own holiday list.
